subject.title: Feature request: message delete (revoke) action for WhatsApp channel

question: What destructive-action contract should WhatsApp message revocation use, including its public action name, ownership checks, and definition of successful recipient-side deletion?
rationale: Baileys exposes the transport operation, but repository evidence cannot safely choose whether delete and unsend are aliases, whether confirmation is required, or what server response is sufficient to claim retraction.

options.title: Approve guarded unsend
options.body: Expose one canonical action for bot-owned messages only and require authorization, reliable failure surfacing, and live recipient-side proof before landing.

options.title: Require confirmation
options.body: Gate each WhatsApp revocation behind an explicit user approval step in addition to ownership and target authorization.

options.title: Keep manual deletion
options.body: Do not expose revocation until WhatsApp server behavior can provide a sufficiently reliable success signal.

recommendation.title: Approve guarded unsend
recommendation.body: Expose one canonical action for bot-owned messages only and require authorization, reliable failure surfacing, and live recipient-side proof before landing.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the documented repository maintainer, previously reviewed this exact product boundary, and have recent history on the affected WhatsApp action surface.
